nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 - Video DeltaNet (VDN) Hybrid Attention

This workflow runs **Video DeltaNet (VDN)** hybrid attention on MiniMax H3 via the ApplyVDNH3 node. VDN replaces most of H3's heavy softmax attention with a hybrid design — a sliding-window softmax branch for local detail plus a linear-attention branch for long-range context — that scales **linearly with clip length instead of quadratically**. The upshot: the longer and higher-res your clip, the more VDN helps.

**Honest expectations:** this is an experimental PyTorch port of VDN for ComfyUI (by Saganaki22). The headline "75-90x / faster-than-playback" figures are from the official release on 8x B200 datacenter GPUs, not consumer hardware. On a normal GPU this runs an extra linear branch on every block, so it needs solid VRAM — it shines on long/high-res clips, not short ones. If you're VRAM-limited, the fused turbo or standard turbo workflows are the lighter choice.

VDN node by **Saganaki22**: https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-VDN-H3
VDN model/research by **OpenVDN**: https://huggingface.co/OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3

### Key inputs
- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes
- **vdn_checkpoint**: the VDN adapter (see download below)
- **prompt**: shot, motion, and audio in one block
- **width/height**: Resolution Selector (768px short edge, multiple of 32)

nodes.title: Note: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**Base H3 models** (from Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3):
- diffusion_models/ -> minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors -> ComfyUI/models/unet/
- text_encoders/ -> qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors -> ComfyUI/models/clip/
- vae/ -> minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors + minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors -> ComfyUI/models/vae/

**VDN checkpoint** (by OpenVDN) -> ComfyUI/models/vdn/
Download with the Hugging Face CLI (grabs the specific split checkpoint):
`hf download OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3 --include "stage-dmd-step-250/*" --local-dir models/vdn`

Set the CLIPLoader type to krea2. VDN node: Saganaki22/ComfyUI-VDN-H3.

She stands confidently in a beautiful fantasy environment, then suddenly bursts into energetic martial-arts movement. She performs a fluid sequence of fast punches, spinning kicks, an acrobatic aerial flip, and a powerful final kick, moving with the speed, balance, and playful agility of a feline. Her expression is confident, mischievous, and charismatic, occasionally smiling as she fights.

The camera dynamically follows her movements with cinematic tracking shots, low angles, close-ups, and smooth camera arcs. Her hair, tail, clothing, and fabric react naturally to her movements. Brief slow motion emphasizes one spectacular spinning kick before returning to fast action.

Highly detailed realistic skin and fur, realistic anatomy, natural facial expressions, physically believable movement, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, detailed fantasy environment, dramatic atmosphere, polished high-budget live-action fantasy film aesthetic. Energetic, cool, playful, visually striking, charismatic, fluid, exciting.

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
